newsitems.title: 10,000 Wishlists!
newsitems.author: JakeHub
newsitems.contents: We just passed 10,000 wishlists! Thanks to everyone who’s supported Scam With Your Friends so far. We’ve got a lot more coming soon.If you’re a creator, feel free to make content on the game! You can use anything from our press kit here:https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1T-lfJFGo4vfhlwNFhjWr9GZ3ULWqPoh9?usp=sharingAnd make sure to join our Discord for updates, announcements, and sneak peeks!https://discord.com/invite/jataterww
